Author: Dongge
Name: Smart Shooters
Description: Your ranged units shoot the most dangerous enemies first: siege engines and enemy archers, then engineers, melee troops and hard-hitting workers; the hard-to-kill lord, rams and mantlets last. Ten categories with adjustable tiers; separate switches for your own, allied and enemy units. Arc-aware range check: archers also shoot enemies behind walls or on a keep when nothing else is in reach.
